results.name: Ruined Aqueduct Arches Segment
results.description:
A highly detailed ruined aqueduct segment, a two-tier run of tall stone arches with three bays surviving while the fourth has collapsed into a pile of voussoir blocks. The open water channel running along the top is choked with dried silt and weeds, pale mineral staining streaks down the piers, and iron cramp holes pock the stonework. This model was produced using AI-assisted generation as part of an ongoing dark fantasy and historical ruins series. Realistic sun-bleached stone, mineral crust and dry weed textures with physically-based materials make this a game-ready environment asset with clean topology, ideal for ancient Roman-style landscapes, abandoned civilizations, or gothic horror scenes. The structure includes its own integral pier footings and rubble but no surrounding terrain, so it can be placed directly into any valley, wasteland, or overgrown environment.
